Reason for modification: terminate for convenience (complete or partial). termination for convenience agreement - the kutztown university's h2o+h2s "here to observe + here to storytell" program will use mission science and scientific storytelling as a student experiential learning tool to scaffold workforce skills. each year, the 10-12 student observer cohort will be composed of stem and stem-interested freshmen, sophomores and incoming transfer students from introductory courses. the program will focus on those students not typically served by outreach and engagement programs. kutztown university has an established 'learning community' approach, where a group of students is paired with faculty mentors and meet once a week as a part of their schedule. h2o+h2s will use this program so students are supported with a 1-credit course (1 hour per week), preserving dedicated time for the student observer to fulfill the program without disruption to their academic classes or overburdening schedules. the course will integrate the here to explore program activities with a student-created scientific narrative project based on sharing the mission science. the students observers will develop a short audio/video storytelling project about the NASA mission. research shows that integrating storytelling, or narrative techniques, provides powerful access for students of diverse backgrounds to connect with science. two students from previous cohorts will serve as peer mentors. scaffolding experiences will include the NASA-led h2o activities, fieldtrips, professional meeting attendance, and mentorship through-out the year. the h2o + h2s program focuses on creating products that articulate workforce skills on student resumes. this directly supports enhanced student success when applying for future internships, graduate school, and industry jobs.
